segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹמֵר לִבְנוֹ: ״שְׁטָר בֵּין שְׁטָרוֹתַי פָּרוּעַ, וְאֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ אֵי זֶהוּ״ – שְׁטָרוֹת כּוּלָּן פְּרוּעִין. נִמְצָא לְאֶחָד שָׁם שְׁנַיִם – הַגָּדוֹל פָּרוּעַ, וְהַקָּטָן אֵינוֹ פָּרוּעַ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who says to his son» before dying: One promissory «note among» the promissory «notes» in «my» possession «is repaid, but I do not know which one, the» promissory «notes of all of» those who owe him money «are» considered «repaid,» i.e., they are not valid for collection, as it cannot be determined which debt was repaid and which are outstanding. If there were «found» among his papers «two» promissory notes owed «by one» person, the one for «the greater» amount «is» considered «repaid, and» the one for «the smaller» amount «is not» considered «repaid» and can be collected; the debtor is favored in the case of an uncertainty.

moves.summary: if one unidentified note is repaid, all are repaid
of two notes from one debtor, the larger is repaid

positions.claim: all notes are treated as repaid; of two notes of one debtor, the larger is repaid
